blurb: Traveling Tykes rents various inflatables and amusement equipment for events, including slides, water rides, mechanical rides, moonbounces, obstacle courses, and games. Rentals require a minimum of 2 hours and can be extended to full-day rentals of 5 hours. Equipment is delivered and set up on suitable flat surfaces, with power requirements and safety instructions provided.
extraNote: Minimum rental period is 2 hours; full-day rental is 5 hours · Reservations are first come first served; can book as late as day before event or sometimes same day · No refunds due to bad weather once equipment is delivered; company may cancel for storms with heavy rain or winds over 15 mph · Renter must sign a rental agreement prior to event
